description: This file contains internal implementation details for the 'cord' data structure in the Abseil library, including class definitions, memory management, reference counting, and representation of string data and related structures.

classes.name: RefcountAndFlags
classes.description: Manages reference counting and state flags for CordRep instances using atomic operations.

classes.name: InlineData
classes.description: Represents inline string data or a tree structure for the 'cord' data structure, with support for profile data and sanitizer poisoning.

classes.name: CordRep
classes.description: Base class for various string representation types used internally by the 'cord' data structure.

classes.name: CordRepSubstring
classes.description: Represents a substring view into another CordRep node.

classes.name: CordRepExternal
classes.description: Represents an external string with a custom releaser.

classes.name: CordRepExternalImpl
classes.description: Template class for external CordRep with a custom releaser, using EBCO for space optimization.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new CordRepSubstring representing a substring of a child CordRep.

methods.name: Substring
methods.description: Creates a substring view of a CordRep, possibly sharing underlying data.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes an external CordRep, invoking its releaser.

methods.name: Ref
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a CordRep.

methods.name: Unref
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and destroys the CordRep if count reaches zero.
